title: Round23 Unit09 drawn anatomy patches expose inherited ghost-hand layer
summary: Edited actual retained Round22 96x160 frames with authored native raster clusters for six boot poses, three hand orientations and a clipped pelvic plate, keeping upper 76 rows byte-identical. Eight local iterations rejected connector overpaint, cuff/material mismatch, blocky palms and scarf clipping. Layer inspection found Round22 scarf overlap also retained a static neutral left hand; final study removes that inherited hand mask while preserving the active forearm above the new cuff. Regression checks verify all visible source scarf-strip pixels unchanged, hand-cuff contact, connected alpha, eight distinct body/lower silhouettes, actual sole-pixel stage projection and lossless six-layer ASE decoding. File gate passes front-only; visual and animation gates still FAIL due material integration, incomplete hip/thigh perspective and cloth motion. Editor and Android runtime NOT TESTED. No private art or engine changes published.
